outcome: weekly decrease-rate of beta Human Chorionic Gonadotropin subunit (beta-HCG)
time between MTX administration and surgery
cohort: 14 patients diagnosed with Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP) before the 10th week of gestation.
finding: Both systemic and local MTX administration, followed by hysteroscopic placental removal, were effective for treating CSP, but local MTX resulted in faster trophoblastic demise and earlier surgery.
